title: feature/2152
summary: Since the last plan (commit `94b2f92`), the book name text no longer shrinks for every book: it stays at its normal size and only gets smaller when the bar itself is too narrow. On a phone, the bar at the bottom of the reader shows the current book and chapter between two arrows. Long book names like Song of Solomon and 1 and 2 Thessalonians used to be cut off there. This change gives the book name more room (slimmer arrow areas) and lets its text shrink a little only when needed, so the whole name should fit.

links.label: Issue 2152: Improve display of Song of Solomon on mobile

setup.title: Use a phone
setup.body: These tests need a phone (iPhone or Android). The bar being tested only appears on phone-sized screens, so a computer browser won't show it. A smaller phone (for example an iPhone SE, iPhone mini, or a compact Android) is the best test, because that's where names got cut off. If you have two phones of different sizes, try both.

setup.title: Open the preview build on the phone
setup.body: Open the preview link above in your phone's browser (Safari or Chrome). You don't need to sign in. If the preview shows an error or doesn't load, wait a few minutes and reload; the build may still be deploying.

setup.title: Make sure you have the new version
setup.body: The app caches itself, so it can show an older version. If things look exactly like before, close the tab and open the link again, or open it in a private/incognito tab for a clean start.

setup.title: Find the bar at the bottom
setup.body: At the bottom of the reader there's a rounded bar with a left arrow, the book name and chapter number (for example **John 1**), and a right arrow. Tapping the book name opens the list of books and chapters. If you scroll down and the bottom toolbar slides away, this bar stays in view.

sections.title: Long book names fit on a phone
sections.intro: The problem from issue 2152: long book names were cut off in the bottom bar.

tests.title: Song of Solomon shows its full name
tests.why: This is the exact case from issue 2152, which asks that the user can see the entire book name without it being cut off.
steps: Hold the phone upright (portrait).
Tap the book name in the bottom bar.
Choose **Song of Solomon**, then chapter **1**.
Look at the bottom bar.
expected: The bar shows the whole name **Song of Solomon** with the chapter number. No letters are missing and there's no `…` at the end.
The text is still easy to read (a little smaller than before is fine).

tests.title: 1 Thessalonians and 2 Thessalonians show their full names
tests.why: Issue 2152 names these two books as also being cut off.
steps: Tap the book name in the bottom bar and choose **1 Thessalonians**, chapter **1**.
Look at the bottom bar.
Tap the book name again and choose **2 Thessalonians**, chapter **1**.
Look at the bottom bar.
expected: Both times, the bar shows the whole book name (**1 Thessalonians** / **2 Thessalonians**) and the chapter number, with nothing cut off and no `…`.

tests.title: Long names with a two-digit chapter still fit
tests.why: A longer chapter number takes more room. Song of Solomon only has 8 chapters, so this uses other long names with more chapters.
steps: Tap the book name and choose **Deuteronomy**, chapter **34**.
Look at the bottom bar.
Then choose **Ecclesiastes**, chapter **12**, and look again.
expected: Both book names and chapter numbers are shown in full. If the bar doesn't have room for one line, the chapter number may move to a second line, but the book name itself is not cut off.

tests.title: Other long book names fit
steps: Use the book list to open each of these, chapter 1: **Lamentations**, **1 Chronicles**, **2 Corinthians**, **Philippians**.
Look at the bottom bar for each one.
expected: Every book name is shown in full, with no `…`. Note in your results any name that's still cut off and which phone you used.

tests.title: Short book names don't look tiny
tests.why: Changed since commit `94b2f92`: on that commit the text shrank for every book on every phone; now it should stay at its normal size unless the bar is too narrow. Short names should look like a normal bold title, not small print.
steps: Open **John 3**.
Look at the bottom bar.
expected: **John 3** is clearly readable and looks like a bold title, the same size as before this change, not small print.

tests.title: Names fit on the narrowest screen you can try
tests.why: Changed since commit `94b2f92`: the text now keeps its full size on most phones and only shrinks when the bar is very narrow, so the smallest screens are where a long name is most likely to still be cut off. Issue 2152 asks for the full name on small phones.
tests.before: Only if you can: use the smallest phone you have, or turn on your phone's zoomed display (iPhone: Settings > Display & Brightness > Display Zoom > **Larger Text**; Android: Settings > Display > **Display size** set to the largest). Skip this test if you can't.
steps: Reload the preview.
Open **Song of Solomon 1**, then **1 Thessalonians 1**.
Look at the bottom bar each time.
expected: The full book name is shown for both, with no `…` at the end. If a name is cut off here, mark the test Fail and note your phone model and setting.

sections.title: Things that should not have changed
sections.intro: The arrows around the book name got slimmer to make room, so check they still work well.

tests.title: The arrows are still easy to tap
steps: Open **Song of Solomon 1**.
Tap the right arrow in the bottom bar a few times.
Tap the left arrow a few times.
Try tapping near the outer edge of each arrow, not just the middle.
expected: Each tap on the right arrow moves to the next chapter, and each tap on the left arrow goes back one. The book name and chapter number update each time.
Taps near the arrow's edge still count; you don't have to hit it exactly. Tapping an arrow doesn't open the book list by mistake.

tests.title: Tapping the book name still opens the book list
steps: Tap anywhere on the book name in the bottom bar.
expected: The list of books and chapters opens.

tests.title: The bar looks right while audio is playing
tests.why: While a chapter is read aloud, the same bar shows what's playing, so the text change affects it too.
steps: Open **Song of Solomon 1**.
Tap the play button at the left of the bottom bar to start the audio.
Look at the bar, then tap play again (or the pause button) to stop.
expected: While playing, the bar's label is readable and not cut off, and the previous and next buttons still work.
After stopping, the bar goes back to showing **Song of Solomon 1** in full.

tests.title: Turning the phone sideways still looks right
steps: Open **Song of Solomon 1**.
Turn the phone sideways (landscape), then back upright.
expected: In both directions the bar (if shown) has the full book name, the text isn't oversized or squashed, and the arrows sit at each end.

notCovered: Computers and tablets: the bar being changed only appears on phone-sized screens, so wider screens are unaffected.
Book names in other languages: the change applies to them too, but this plan only checks English names.
